name: kaamsetu-monorepo
description: KaamSetu: hyperlocal marketplace for short-term manual work (development monorepo; the deployable app is generated into dist-deploy/).

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @kaamsetu/web" "npm run dev -w @kaamsetu/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @kaamsetu/web && npm run build -w @kaamsetu/api
